answer: Leather hides hang drying in the carver workshop, the punches laid out in a row. Proof of wayang-puppet carver via leather puppet tally — a puppet the carver cuts only after 27 puppets hold their leather without one tearing at the joint, each cut by the carver himself. vault traces the figure on the hide and cuts along the line with the knife. glacier punches the fine holes, each one clean. meadow paints the puppet gold and red, then joints the arms. Twenty-seven puppets must hold their leather without one tearing at the joint, and the next still tears where the hide was stretched too far.
